title: Core Functions (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX)

activities.title: Add a summary block to your inventory
activities.intro: Open your Lab3 Inventory file. Type the labels in column A and the functions in column E, then enter what each cell shows.

items: In C10 type =SUM(C2:C9). In E10 replace the long + formula with =SUM(E2:E9).

blocks.prompt: What does E10 show (total stock value)?
What does E12 show (number of items)?
What does E13 show (average unit cost)?
What does E14 show (average total cost)?
What does E15 show (lowest unit cost)?
What does E16 show (highest unit cost)?
What does E17 show (highest total cost)?
What does E18 show (lowest total cost)?
Optional: a screenshot of your summary block

help: Ranges stop at row 9, never row 10, or you count the total too.
E12 shows ₱8.00? It picked up Currency formatting. Set the cell to Number or General so it reads 8.
A different number? Click the cell and read the range in the formula bar. It is almost always the range.
Google Sheets and Calc: use the Σ button, or type =SUM( and drag over the cells.
